Custody holds at both ends: the subject measures 5de3c238 at 0444, 7676 bytes and 158 lines, unmoved and unedited, equal to the prompt's pin; HEAD never left ffe5bdd; COORD and file 08 are byte-unmoved and equal to the subject's own citations; COORD's last heading is D-223 and no D-224 heading exists. All eleven digest citations reproduce, including both occupancy v3 Stage A verdicts, which are ACCEPT 0/0 and both mode 0444, and frozen v1 and rejected v2, which are cited only with disqualifying parentheticals. The v2-to-v3 repair narrative I confirmed against frozen v2's own bytes rather than the subject's account: v2 doesNot[27] read 'Does not change required-now 26.' against its own requiredNowUnchanged 28, and both v2 reviewers named that one site — Claude as blocker MF-1, Codex as SHOULD-FIX CODEX-G24-V2-SF1 — while v3 doesNot[27] now reads 'Does not change live required-now 28.' byte-exact. Identifier discipline is clean in both directions: Claude v2's A-1 and A-2 are preserved, the shared v2 class is carried under both reviewers' identifiers, and no identifier is attached to any v3 roster, matching Codex v3's observationCount 0 and Claude v3's absent observations key. The recording claims reproduce from their sources: leftover-join.v3 (D-199) is the current G24 leftover-join with leftoverDesign exactly ['OBL-G24-FX-AUTHORING'] and the other three obligations measured false, so FX-AUTHORING remains and is not closed; the INPUT basis g24-input-corpus.v1 has no successor; parentReview is the D-150 dual CONSENT with both verdicts confirmed CONSENT from their own files; gate-harness-naming.v6 contains no DR-G24 at all. Live standing is unchanged and independently re-derived: 32 gate rows, 28 carrying a recorded identifier, DR-G24 and DR-131 both OPEN, last gate row DR-G32, condition 2 at 4 of 32 and condition 4 MET at 28 of 28 / 32 of 32. The non-unwrite span is exactly D-167 through D-223, 57 entries, verified by set comparison with zero gaps and zero extras, D-168 and D-223 both present. The draft is a faithful increment of the adopted D-223 template; the one guard it drops, the D-143 disclaimer, is subject-specific to G23 and there is no unadopted G24 occupancy draft to disclaim. Recording remains a separate coordinator act.
